english.title: Make a false representation / omission in connection with a duty relating to a debt relief order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in respect of whom a debt relief order had been made, knowingly or recklessly made a false

(A)_[representation,]_
(B)_[omission,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY REPRESENTATION/OMISSION..), in providing information to the official receiver in connection with

(C)_[a duty under section 251J(5) of the Insolvency Act 1986, namely **(..SPECIFY DUTY..), in connection with]_
(D)_[performance by him of functions in relation to]_
(E)_[performance by her of functions in relation to]_

a debt relief order
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 251O(4)(b), 251T(3) and 430 of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence was inserted by section 108(1) of and Schedule 17 to the Tribunals, Courts and Enforcement Act 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years and / or a fine.

Note: In relation to offences committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (limit on magistrates' court powers to impose imprisonment), the reference to "twelve months" is to be read as a reference to "six months".

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
